sourceData.meaningMnemonic: Who's that <radical>woman</radical> pretending to be a <radical>jet</radical>? That's my <kanji>younger sister</kanji>. *Sigh*
sourceData.readingMnemonic: Your <kanji>younger sister</kanji> is giving some <reading>mi</reading>ce (<ja>まい</ja>) a ride on her back like a jet.
sourceData.meaningInfo: Imagine a little girl (your younger sister) running around with her arms out, pretending to be a jet, too. Prwoooooo!
sourceData.readingInfo: Ew, gross. Your younger sister is such a weirdo! Why does she have mice on her back while pretending to be a jet?
